batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b Akash Singh

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b RA Jadeja

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c Akash Singh b RA Jadeja

batting.name: AK Markram
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b M Theekshana

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b M Pathirana

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: st MS Dhoni b RA Jadeja

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b M Markande

balls.text: run-out off the last ball! But it has gone to the third umpire, who confirms it is out. Dhoni takes his right glove off, and hits the stumps at his end to find Sundar short. Length ball heading down to end outside leg, as Jansen swung across the line and missed. Naturally, they took for a potential bye
short delivery now just outside off. Good bounce and carry, as someone even as tall as Jansen can't pull that
full and outside leg. Slinging down, and wide called
swung wide of deep third! Theekshana tried his best running and diving to his right, but couldn't stop. Full and wide outside off, as Jansen threw his bat at it with an aerial slash
slower ball on a good length outside off. Jansen pulls but misses, as the ball also keeps low
full toss just outside off. The ball is dipping, as Sundar loses his bottom hand while pushing to mid-off
gets across, as Pathirana fires a yorker wide of off. Hoicked towards deep midwicket off the bottom of the bat
change of pace, on a full length on leg. Chipped to long-on
full toss which is wide of off, and is flat-batted to extra cover
brilliant shot! Expertly lofted over mid-off, with high elbows. Good length ball around middle and off, and he made room to ram that back
low full toss on leg - perhaps an attempted yorker - and slammed to deep midwicket
slower ball, just what should work on this pitch. On a length on middle, and angling down to end outside leg, as Jansen - standing by making room - swings and misses
lofts to deep point on the bounce. Full and wide of off, as he opens the bat face to play from deep in the crease
short ball on middle, with Sundar pulling to deep backward square almost while skipping in the crease
fires a yorker on off, which is dragged to extra cover
just short of Deshpande sprinting forward from deep third! A late ramp by Sundar at this shortish ball wide of off, as the ball flew off his bat

another good catch by Gaikwad! Again he dives forward - but this time at extra cover - like he had done to dismiss Brook earlier in the day. Klaasen got a length delivery slightly wide of off from Pathirana, as he saw the width and flashed hard at the ball. The ball ended up being aerial, with Gaikwad timing his dive perfectly
hoicks it to long-on aerially, as he sits low to loft this length ball outside off
quite full just outside off. Heaved to long-on
yorker on middle at 104kph, and squeezed out
again backs away, and punches this length ball heading down leg to long-off
four over extra cover! He made room to this length ball on the stumps, and slammed that over the in field to go inside out
good length outside off, and slashed to long-off
very full and quicker on off. Reverse swept to short third
skips out, and swings across the line to deep square leg, as the ball is on a length on off. That came off the inside half of the bat though
short ball, at a change of pace. Hits Jansen on above his stomach, as there is good bounce too, with Jansen missing his attempted pull. The ball trickled towards the on side in the end
short delivery outside off, and he sways out of the way
length ball wide of off, and hacked to deep point again
full and wide of off. Poked to deep point
slower, and short in length on middle. Jansen rides the bounce and dabs to point
good length ball skids through on off. Clipped towards square leg off the inside half of the bat
flat, full and quicker just outside off. Jansen tries to reverse sweep but is beaten
short and quicker on leg. Pulled to fine leg
turns in slightly off a full length, and ends on middle. Pushed to long-off
looked like the carrom ball, but it was very full on leg. Klaasen made room, and drilled to long-off
very full and straight. Dragged to long-on
good length on the stumps. Clipped to deep midwicket
full ball heading down leg. Flicked towards deep square, and they grab two

stumped by Dhoni! And for what it's worth, the third umpire first wants to confirm if it's a caught behind or a stumping. No bat detected, so Agarwal is out stumped. He ended wayyy down the pitch, skipping out early. Jadeja saw that, and fired one on a short of a length outside off, and also much quicker. Agarwal had to slash but missed, and Dhoni did the rest
full ball on off, and driven to long-off
flicks this behind square, and they nab two there
drives to the on side
ah, did Klaasen didn't let Jadeja grab that!? The non-striker there, he went moved to his left, as Agarwal chipped this length ball on off back. Jadeja and Klaasen clashed, and so it wasn't caught
chipped to deep midwicket, as the ball is on a length outside off

wow, what a faint tickle! Good take by Dhoni; he hardly had time to react. The ball sticks into his gloves as he leaps a little. It was a short ball pitching outside off, as Markram made room to try and slash it. He got his front leg out of the way too, but ended up getting a little top edge
good length on the stumps, and poked to long-on
full and flatter on off. Punched to long-on
aerial punch to long-off, as the ball is on a length on off
chips this full ball just outside off to long-on
short on off, and again punched to cover
on the bounce to cover! Pushed forward at that length ball on off
fuller ball on the stumps, and pushed to long-off
good length on off, and punched to long-off

top edge, and taken by short fine leg! The fielder only had to move to his left to gobble that. Tripathi tries to slog sweep this full delivery, but it's a bit wide-ish of off for him to fetch that and play across the line. Looked like the ball also stopped while coming on to him, as he was through his shot there
good length on middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
quite full just outside off, and jammed back. Pathirana gets his left hand to it, as the ball dribbles behind the wicket
short delivery at 138kph, and that shoots off from middle and off. Markram sways out after shaping to pull
much fuller ball on off, and driven back. Pathirana stops that with his right boot
ah, great timing! Just uses the pace of the bowler, who bowls shortish just outside off. Markram only pushed at it to beat the point fielder to his left
clipped off his pads, as this full ball heads down the leg side. Single to fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Punched to long-on
keeps low off a good length on the stumps, and skids through. Clipped towards midwicket with his front leg out of the way
reverse lofted to deep backward point. Full and outside leg, going down with the angle, as Tripathi swung his arms early
full on off, and lofted wide of long-off, as he goes inside out with the open face of the bat
good length on middle. Clipped towards deep midwicket

well taken by Rahane at long-on! He had to cover good ground while running forward. So the time-out breaks Abhishek's momentum. Short ball from Jadeja from around the wicket, pitching just outside off. That didn't really turn, even as Abhishek pulled from middle stump perhaps anticipating it. The ball hit the higher side of his bat, and ballooned to long-on
length ball, turning away a bit towards middle. Stabbed to cover
shortish, and turning into middle. Clipped to fine leg
good length on middle and off, and tucked towards square leg
on the bounce to long-on! Shorter from Mo, as it turns in towards off
now slog sweeps over short fine! Got down and across early, as Mo bowled on a good length on middle
turns in off a length from outside off, as Mo slows it down. Hit on the helmet as he tried to sweep
tossed up, and full on middle and leg. Driven to long-off
gets an inside edge, as he defends this good length ball on the stumps
good length on middle, turning in. Clipped to fine leg
late turn away, and dabbed to short third's left. Pathirana dives to save that, as Jadeja bowled shortish outside off
full just outside off. Pushed to long-on
good length on middle, and nudged towards midwicket
guides this good length ball outside off very late, and beats short third to his left. Four to begin with
length ball hinting to turn in from outside off. Tucked down
short and outside off. Swatted to long-off
gets quite across off early, and half-scoops to short fine leg. Length ball, and slower just outside off from Moeen
length ball wide of off. Slashed aerially to deep point
sweeps this full ball on off to deep backward square
just wide of the long-on fielder running to his right! Tripathi clears his front leg, and launches at this loopy and full ball on middle to welcome Moeen
finally gets one away! Again he makes room, and goes inside out over extra cover to beat long-off to his right. Full delivery on the stumps, and he lofted confidently
very full and quicker on leg. Jammed to mid-off's right for a single
fuller than the last ball, arriving on middle. Makes room and again flashes in the gap between point and cover

just over Ruturaj, the point fielder! And then a good stop by Moeen, running from extra cover to the deep point boundary, as he pulls it back very late. Shorish ball, angling away, as Abhishek makes room and lofts over point
gets down to sweep, but is hit on his pad outside off. The ball dribbles towards short fine
good length ball, hinting to turn away towards middle. Punched to long-off
fullish ball almost straightening on off. Bunted to cover's left, where Moeen fumbles, but the ball is taken cleanly by cover-point
another play and miss. Good length again just outside off, as Tripathi tries to slash but misses
now charges down the pitch and tries to hack, but is beaten. Good length ball around off, which heads further away from him, as he reaches out for the ball
ah, played that very late! Opened the bat face to push to point, as the length ball angled towards off

taken at backward point! Good, low catch by Gaikwad. The ball was hit very hard, and there was little time for Gaikwad to react. Length delivery from Akash, which was angling across and finished in the channel outside off. Brook made a bit of room and flashed, but the ball flew off the outside half of his bat, and behind the wicket

another mix-up, and Conway misses the direct hit! Shortish ball outside off, which was hacked to cover-point. Abhishek took off for a run, as Conway missed the stumps at the striker's end. The result was an overthrow, and they pinched a run
scooped behind the wicket! Two boundaries to get going for Brook. He went low and across off - like the attempted scoop earlier - and connected this time, as the length ball arrived on middle
makes room, and thrashes to deep point! Waits for the fullish ball on the stumps to arrive, and slashes it hard and wide of the man at deep backward point
slower ball now. Length ball on off, as he taps halfway towards point and takes off, but Abhishek sends him back
looks to scoop after getting across, but doesn't get bat on ball. Good length on middle, and that angled down leg. Wide not given
good length on middle and off, and clipped to the short midwicket fielder's right for two
guides this shortish ball angling across to end on sixth stump. Single to deep third
back of a length, ending on off after angling across. Dabbed to point, as he is sent back
good length ball heading into leg. Nudged to mid-on for a quick single

just clears the fine-leg fielder! He was in business right until the last moment though. It was a length ball on middle, which hinted to angle in, but Abhishek played an elegant flick shot to send it sailing
hits the inside half of his bat for the third time in a row. Goes flashing at this full and wide ball outside off, as the ball ends at fine leg
pushes at this length ball on off to mid-on, as the ball hits the inside half of his bat again
gets it off the inside half of the bat, as he leans into a drive to this length ball angling across to finish wide of off. Eventually the ball went towards fine leg
swatted wide of deep third! Cleared his front leg, and went attacking this short ball ending a bit wide of off after angling across. Another over ends with a four
Dhoni sticks his right glove up, and gobbles it. First-bouncer called, as Deshpande banged it in short on middle, before the ball took off while Abhishek ducked
good length ball on fifth stump. Punched to cover
a late flick - that looked like almost a last-moment decision - as this length ball angled across, and ended outside off. Went over square leg quite safely though
back of a length, angling into leg from middle stump. Clipped to square leg

Brook was gone had Moeen hit the stumps! There was no run there, as the ball was short and wide of off, and Abhishek bunted to cover. Moeen went to his right and threw at the bowler's end, but quite wide, even as Brook was halfway down
starts with a wide. Shortish length outside leg, as it angles down further, with Abhishek trying to pull but missing
drilled down the pitch! A quiet over so far ends with a four. Very full and in the channel outside off, as Brook jammed that back between the non-striker and the stumps
fullish ball right on the stumps, as this one looked like straightening. Pushed back to the bowler
now goes shorter on a length on off. Tucked just to mid-on's left for a hurried single
fuller side of a length while pitching on fifth stump. Hints to angle away, and is pushed to cover
gets an inside edge, as he defends forward at this good length ball on sixth stump
back of a length on middle. Clipped to fine leg, as Abhishek is sent back by Brook for an attempted second
there's the win! Moeen sees this tossed up and belts this down the ground to beat mid-on.
makes room and punches to point
reverse swept to short third, good stop by Umran.  Scores level
driven to deep cover

off the edge and it races away. Umran digs it in short, Conway is looking to help it along but the ball flies off the thick edge as he then later tries to withdraw the bat seemingly because he's beaten for pace.
lofted over cover! Stand and deliver stuff that.
hangs back expecting a short of length delivery, bunts it into the leg side as it arrives and takes the run
dot ball again as he bowls length on middle, defended
hustles him with a length ball from around the stumps. Moeen gets one off the inner part of the bat to shoot midwicket
pushed into the off side, wide of shot third for a single
cracker of a delivery! Fizzing googly that has Rayudu playing down the wrong line. The ball sneaks in to beat the inside edge and crash into the stumps. What a ball.
short, wider and slapped to deep cover
beaten by the googly. Went for a massive slog sweep but didn't pick that one
punched to deep point
sees him coming and drifts it wider, Conway drives to sweeper cover
steps out but ends up getting too close to the pitches he hits it back to the bowler
it's a lovely late cut from Rayudu that beats a diving Markande. It appeared as if he wouldn't have room to play that shot but he still manufactured it so very well
flat-batted down to long-on
off the pad and into the leg side, they scamper a leg bye. Rayudu was nearly beaten by the skid again.

steps out but Mayank drops short as he sees him coming, Rayudu offers his pad to it. There's a massive appeal that has Markram opt for the DRS. Looks like the impact was outside off. Let's see. Hawkeye shows the ball would've grazed the stumps but it comes back as umpire's call on the point of impact. So not out it is.
deft touch to pick the gap at short third, nicely done
tossed up on middle, defended back
works this wrong'un to long-on to get off the mark
shortish on off, defended

rewarded for a superb delivery! Rahane chips down the track but is beaten in flight and off the pitch as he attempts to work it to the leg side. The ball flies off the edge to Markram who leaps at slip to complete the catch on the second attempt.
whips this to deep midwicket
too much flight and Conway absolutely drills that one down the ground. Although long-off was just a few metres from he ball, he stood no chance of intercepting that
driven to wide long-off as Markande tosses this up
worked with the angle through midwicket
follows that thump with a nudge into the leg side
hammered! Dagar drops too short in the hope of trying to skid that across, Conway makes room and slaps that away wide of cover to beat wide long-off
shortish on middle and leg, Rahane punches this towards wide long-on
neatly chipped over cover for a couple
nice drift back in from around the stumps, Rahane defends back
worked to deep square as Rahane keeps busy
whips it down to long-on
squirted off a thick inside edge into the left side
beaten by the skid off the pitch as he's struck on the back leg. SRH don't review, angle was taking if down from a round the stumps
eased down long-on
eased with the spin to long-off
works it through to deep midwicket
looking go over cover but the ball drifted away from Conway's hitting arc
whips this to deep midwicket
swept down to deep backward square
beaten as he rocks back to cut this away-drifter
Rahane off the mark straightaway as he works it through midwicket

what an unfortunate way to see a wicket fall. Conway absolutely hits this ramrod straight, and it deflects off Umran's fingers onto the stumps at the non-striker's end with Gaikwad not even in the frame. Umran was late to react on his followthrough but somehow managed to get his fingertips on the ball. Also had some luck go his way with that. Conway is distraught at seeing his partner walk off in the most unfortunate fashion.
right behind the line of this fullish delivery as he defends
mistimes this drive to mid-off but scampers a quick single
beaten for pace as he looks to take on the short ball at 145kph. Whizzes past the gloves
hops right back and defends
yorker at 149kph, Gaikwad jams his bat down int time to keep that out
looks to nudge it leg side but is hit on the pad as the ball skids through from outside leg
too short and clobbered away as Conway brings up a 33-ball half-century. It's his third on the trot. Rocks back to open up the off side and absolutely slap this half-tracker to the cover fence
shortish outside off, steered to deep point again
lofted inside out over the infield to deep point, two more to the score. Just chipped it up and over with the spin
looking to reverse sweep but is beaten, looks like there was some glove on it through and they take a run
rocks back and cuts to deep point
uses the depth of the crease nicely as he tucks it into the leg side for a sharp single
neatly worked into the gap toward the fielder coming in from deep midwicket. Sensible batting
angles one into the pads from around the stumps, worked to deep square
punches to deep point, speeds to the sweeper like a bullet
pushed to mid-on, refuses the single straightaway
plays the short-arm jab to a short ball at 140 clicks, gets it into the gap at deep midwicket. Seemed more like a tennis shot
eased to sweeper cover
bunts this to cover
right back into the crease as he curdles it into the leg side for a single
rushed onto him off a length as he tried to work it to the leg side, defended awkwardly in the end
picks the wrong'un as he rocks back and pulls this shortish delivery to deep midwicket
shortish on middle and leg, pushed to deep midwicket
tucks this to deep square as they jog the single
punched behind point for a single
slaps this to deep cover point
gets well forward and defends
whips it to deep midwicket
worked into the gap at midwicket, fielder had to come in quite a long way from the ropes

oh my word, this is some batting!  Conway this time decides there's a little more width on the length ball, but doesn't look to cut. Just ends up lending his bat to play a late cut that races away past short third.

deft touch this time! How good is that from Conway? There's more to a T20 innings that just brute force, he says emphatically. Opens the bat face and just deflects it wide of the keeper to the boundary

top-edges the pull and this one flies all the way over the ropes at fine leg. The consequence of the scoop may have been the short ball. Jansen dug it in outside off, Conway looked to fetch it from fifth-stump nearly and because he went through, got enough wood on it to sail over. 50 up for CSK.
gets more bat on it this time! This is fuller on the stumps, Conway has the courage to still get across and scoop it over the man at short fine. Nearly carried all the way.

and more runs! Conway played this ramp very nicely in Bangalore the other night. Does it again. Gets inside the line and helps it wide of short fine. Used the bowler's pace to good effect. Umran Malik was in business for a brief moment there
dabbed to point for a quick single
punched straight to cover point
just over midwicket! Gaikwad was looking to chip this up and over and somehow manages to do that for a couple. But even someone as tall as Jansen couldn't get even his finger tips
bunts it to the man coming in from point for a quick single
punched straight to cover point
sliding into the pads, helped along to deep backward square
short of length on off, punched to mid-off
on a length around leg stump, Gaikwad taps it for a single
gentle dab behind the wicket on the off side as they jog the single
neatly tucked off his hip to deep square
nudged past short midwicket for an easy single
hit high on the body as he looks to pick this behind square on the leg side
rears up awkwardly off a length, Conway is beaten as he shapes to cut
makes a bit of room and punches this between point and short third for a couple
skids one through on a length around middle, turned to the leg side
drifting into the pads, worked wide of mid-on
punched again but straight to cover point
this is even better! Transfers weight back and punches this through extra cover. Can't bowl short and expect to get away with no protection in the deep.
width and flayed through cover point! Conway's fast hands and quick picking of length makes that slap possible.
wrong line and that's too easy for Ruturaj. Tickled off his pads for four.
off the pad again as he looks to flick, down to fine leg
whips this short of length delivery to square leg
lofted over cover. Lovely timing. Planted forward and hit through the line without fear.
works it gently to square leg this time

just clears the infield, Markram retrieves the ball as he runs back from mid-on. Conway was looking to hit straight but the ball appeared to have gripped into the pitch and taken a thickish inside edge.
full and swinging away from outside off, Rutu has a good look at it as he leaves
angles a short of length ball back into the body, Conway looks to whip it up and over square leg but the ball deflects off the thigh pad to fine leg
length on middle, Conway shuffles across a touch and tucks it to the leg side
full and angling into middle, Conway shows the full face of the bat and defends
this time third man is a lot squarer, and so the punch behind point goes down to that man at the rope for a single
what a shot! Stands tall and punches this behind point. No sighters. Up and away, so much elegance and class from Ruth. Incredible to watch.
